title: Regret-Based $(\epsilon,\delta)$-optimal Stopping Criteria for Bayesian Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2605.22561v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a widely used iterative black-box optimization method that utilizes Gaussian process (GP) surrogate models. In practice, BO is typically terminated after a fixed evaluation budget is exhausted, which can incur unnecessary cost and provides no optimality guarantee on solution quality. Recent research in developing a practical stopping criterion has made empirical progress, yet a theoretically sound stopping criterion remains a work in progress. In this work, we present provably tighter instantaneous regret bounds for GP upper confidence bound (GP-UCB) at any given iteration. Then, we propose stopping criteria for GP-UCB based on this tighter bound that ensures an $\epsilon$-optimal solution with high probability $1-\delta$ upon termination. Numerical experiments are performed to validate and demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our stopping criteria.

translated_title: 基于遗憾的贝叶斯优化 $(\epsilon,\delta)$-最优停止准则
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯优化（BO）是一种广泛使用的迭代式黑盒优化方法，其利用高斯过程（GP）代理模型。在实践中，BO 通常在耗尽固定的评估预算后终止，这可能带来不必要的成本，并且无法对解的质量提供最优性保证。近期在开发实用停止准则方面的研究已取得经验性进展，但理论上可靠的停止准则仍在探索之中。在本工作中，我们为 GP 置信上界（GP-UCB）在任意给定迭代时刻提出了可证明更紧的瞬时遗憾界。然后，我们基于这一更紧的界为 GP-UCB 提出了停止准则，该准则可确保在终止时以高概率 $1-\delta$ 获得 $\epsilon$-最优解。我们通过数值实验验证并展示了所提停止准则的有效性和高效性。
tldr: 本文为GP-UCB提出了可证明更紧的瞬时遗憾界，并据此设计了在终止时能以高概率$1-\delta$保证$\epsilon$-最优解的贝叶斯优化停止准则。
